moments.name: Join
moments.description: The relationship begins. Evidence before any ask: bonus paid, Direct Debits moved, nothing automated yet.

moments.name: Stabilise
moments.description: Leaks closing, a fund building, a car loan on plan, a house-deposit pot just started with no rules.

moments.name: Grow
moments.description: Three plans running quietly; idle cash identified; the first investment rehearsed.

moments.name: Graduate
moments.description: A twelve-year relationship: a named human, a mandate, a household by consent, wealth compounding.

note: Four moments = four life stages with a representative customer each (Data/04 §5.4). Each moment is a snapshot with history: change over time lives inside each customer's ledger, rules (since dates), milestones and projections. See README §Design decision.
